# Draft:Politburo of the Mongolian People's Revolutionary Party

}}}}|image=Emblem of the Mongolian People's Revolutionary Party (1930s to 1990).svg|imagesize=|imagecaption=|leader=Jambyn Batmönkh (last)|leader_title=General Secretary|elected_by=Central Committee|responsible_to=Central Committee|seats=7-9 full members2-3 candidate members|meeting_place=Government Palace, Ulaanbaatar|picture=|leader2=}}
The Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the '''Mongolian People's Revolutionary Party,}} or simply Politburo'''}}, was the highest decision-making body of the Mongolian People's Revolutionary Party (MPRP) between sessions of the Party Congress. The MPRP was the sole legal party that ruled the Mongolian People's Republic from the 1921 People's Revolution until the 1990 Democratic Revolution, when the entire Politburo resigned on 12 March 1990.
The members of the Politburo are elected by the Central Committee of the MPRP. The bureau is usually made up of 7 to 9 officials elected from the Central Committee, and 2 to 3 alternate members. The Politburo is headed by the General Secretary.
